audit.scope: read-only; no mount, register access, model, encode, or configuration write
audit.cmdline: console=ttyPS0,115200n8 earlycon=uart8250,mmio32,0xe0004000 loglevel=8 root=/dev/mmcblk0p2 rootwait rw clk_ignore_unused mem=1024M

files.name: UENV.TXT
files.text:
baudrate=115200
bootcmd=run loadbit; run uenvcmd
bootargs=console=ttyPS0,115200n8 earlycon=uart8250,mmio32,0xe0004000 loglevel=8 root=/dev/mmcblk0p2 rootwait rw clk_ignore_unused mem=1024M
uenvcmd=mmc rescan && fatload mmc 0:1 0x10080000 Image && fatload mmc 0:1 0x11000000 fmqlmp-verify.dtb && booti 0x10080000 - 0x11000000
bootdelay=3
loadbit=mmc rescan && fatload mmc 0:2 0x10000000 download.bit && fpga loadb 0 0x10000000 $filesize
bootfile=pxelinux.0
dfu_ram=run dfu_ram_info && dfu 0 ram 0
dfu_ram_info=set dfu_alt_info ${kernel_image} ram 0x3000000 0x500000\\;${devicetree_image} ram 0x2A00000 0x20000\\;${ramdisk_image} ram 0x2000000 0x600000
dnsip=192.168.34.4
ethact=ethernet@e0047000
fdt_high=0x10000000
fdtcontroladdr=3fea6a20
fileaddr=1000000
filesize=419a
fit_image=fit.itb
fit_size=0x800000
flash_off=0x100000
gatewayip=192.168.40.254
initrd_high=0x10000000
ipaddr=192.168.40.86
jtagboot=echo TFTPing FIT to RAM... && tftpboot ${load_addr} ${fit_image} && bootm ${load_addr}
load_addr=0x10000000
netmask=255.255.255.0
nor_flash_off=0xE2100000
norboot=echo Copying FIT from NOR flash to RAM... && cp.b ${nor_flash_off} ${load_addr} ${fit_size} && bootm ${load_addr}
psboot=echo Copying FIT to RAM by lauterbach... && bootm ${load_addr}
sdboot=mmc rescan && fatload mmc 0 0x10000000 /vxWorks
serverip=192.168.40.41
thor_ram=run dfu_ram_info && thordown 0 ram 0
usbboot=if usb start; then echo Copying FIT from USB to RAM... && load usb 0 ${load_addr} ${fit_image} && bootm ${load_addr}
